channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Projeto que nasceu de encontro entre Criolo, Amaro Freitas e Dino vira doc
item.description: Collaborative musical project between Criolo, Amaro Freitas and Dino d'Santiago resulted in an album and documentary 'O Som Entre Nós', highlighting cultural resistance and ancestry. The artists explore sonic connections of the Black Atlantic, with a performance scheduled for the 2026 Festival Estilo Brasil in Brasília.

item.title: "Feira com Lula" e "Onda da Leoa": Ceilândia recebe Celina e Grass nesta 6ª
item.description: The candidates for Governor of the Federal District Leandro Grass (PT) and Celina Leão (PP) hold parallel campaign events in Ceilândia on Friday (10/9). Celina leads the race with 55% of voting intentions, against 37% for Grass, according to a Datafolha poll released on Thursday (10/8).

item.title: Suspeito de elo com PCC, deputado eleito tem precedente desfavorável no TSE
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will analyze a request from the Electoral Public Ministry to invalidate the candidacy of Ney Santos, former mayor of Embu das Artes accused of ties to the PCC and recently elected federal deputy. The case may follow a precedent involving candidates from militias, though the defense claims distinction and ongoing judicial proceedings. A ruling in favor of the MPE could nullify the mandate won with 118,566 votes.

item.title: Em guinada à direita, Nunes reforça aliança com bolsonarismo rumo a 2030
item.description: Ricardo Nunes (MDB), mayor of São Paulo, has deepened his alliance with the Bolsonarismo movement, taking on a leading role in senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign for the 2026 elections. Through strategic actions in the capital, including community-based events and meetings with councilors, Nunes aims to solidify his position to run for the São Paulo state government in 2030. This alignment reflects a shift to the right and strengthens ties with the Bolsonaro family, despite past distancing such as Tarcísio de Freitas's stance.

item.title: Com Flávio à frente, campanha de Lula lista 35 viradas em eleições
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's (PT) campaign reviewed 35 historical comebacks in state elections decided in a second round but acknowledges the challenge of overcoming the narrow 1.87-point deficit to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 second round. Petitioners cite cases such as Eduardo Azeredo's reversal over Hélio Costa in Minas Gerais in 1994 as a theoretical reference.

item.title: Vorcaro conta que liberou dinheiro para filme sobre Lula por negócios no governo
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master, revealed in audio recordings that he paid to fund a film about Lula and negotiated with the PT's former treasurer, João Vaccari Neto, access to federal pension funds. The case involves allegations of banking fraud and bribery, with suspicions of involvement from politicians across different parties, including Flávio Bolsonaro and PT members.

item.title: Mensagens mostram atuação de advogado junto ao governo Lula para tentar salvar banco de Vorcaro
item.description: Messages reveal that lawyer Walfrido Warde acted alongside the Lula government to try to save the defunct Banco Master, intermediating contacts with authorities and even attending a meeting at the Palácio do Planalto with the president. The collaboration aimed to avoid the bank's insolvency, but the efforts were unsuccessful.

item.title: A batalha final entre Flávio e Lula na eleição que revelou um Brasil ainda mais à direita
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro outpolled Lula in the first round, reinforcing the rightward shift in Brazil. The PT leader must reverse the historical disadvantage of first-round winners, while markets react optimistically to expectations of more orthodox fiscal policy.

item.title: Antipetismo vs. antibolsonarismo: o voto 'do contra' que pode decidir a eleição - O Assunto #1822
item.description: The debate in the runoff between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is marked by strong anti-PT and anti-Bolsonaro sentiment, with both candidates facing high rejection rates. The first Datafolha poll shows Flávio with 52% of valid votes against Lula's 48%, indicating that rejection votes may be decisive. Flávio's campaign seeks to reduce his rejection, while Lula needs to consolidate his advantage.

item.title: Temer diz ser alvo de deepfake com críticas ao STF
item.description: Former President Michel Temer released a statement claiming he is the target of deepfake videos that falsely attribute criticisms to the STF. Temer emphasized the content is fake and that legal measures are underway. He recently announced support for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the second round of the presidential election.

item.title: Lula tem 44,2% e Flávio, 42,7% no 2º turno, diz Vox Brasil
item.description: Vox Brasil survey shows Lula at 44.2% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 42.7% in a 2nd round race, within the margin of error. The poll surveyed 2,100 voters between October 5 and 7, 2026.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro estão empatados tecnicamente no segundo turno, diz pesquisa Vox Brasil
item.description: Vox Brasil survey shows a technical tie between Lula (PT) at 44.2% and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 42.7% in the second round, within the 2.15-point margin of error. The shift marks a reversal from the first round, where Flávio held a 3-point lead.

item.title: Violência, corrupção, economia: veja as propostas de Flávio Bolsonaro e de Lula para os temas que mais preocupam os brasileiros
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula are contesting the second round with proposals focused on violence, corruption, and the economy. Flávio emphasizes strict security measures such as lowering the age of criminal responsibility and building megaprisons, while Lula focuses on tactical intelligence and federal investments in public security. Both candidates seek to appeal to voters concerned with insecurity and corruption.

item.title: Horário eleitoral volta nesta sexta-feira (9) para o 2º turno
item.description: The electoral campaign resumes on Friday (9) for the runoff, with ads valid until October 23rd. Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) compete for the presidency, while gubernatorial races advance to runoffs in seven states, including a vote recount in Rio de Janeiro following the annulment of Garotinho's votes.

item.title: Lula retoma atos de campanha para o 2º turno nesta sexta com caminhada no Distrito Federal
item.description: Lula resumes his campaign for the second round with walks in the Federal District and Rio Grande do Norte, focusing on digital outreach and restructuring the team with Northeastern politicians. After acknowledging organizational failures, the PT leader aims to adjust communication strategies and expand social media presence.

item.title: Disputa digital: Lula reúne jovens influenciadores eleitos, e aliados de Flávio organizam reação nas redes
item.description: In the 2026 presidential runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro escalate their digital battle, with Lula gathering influencers and young elected officials to boost social media presence, while Flávio's allies organize responses and mobilize supporters through groups like 'Tropa do Flávio'. Both campaigns use WhatsApp to share content and expand reach, although they claim these efforts are not part of official campaigns.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro fala em acabar com reeleição e aumentar o próprio mandato: entenda como mudança pode ocorrer
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro proposes to eliminate presidential reelection and extend the term from four to five years, changes requiring congressional approval via a constitutional amendment (PEC). He states he will leverage initial political capital to push for the reform, though acknowledges Congress will decide on the term extension. The proposal contradicts recent Brazilian history, as reelection was introduced in 1997 and all presidents since have been reelected except Jair Bolsonaro in 2022.

item.title: Datafolha, 2º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião
item.description: A Datafolha poll for the 2nd round of the 2026 elections shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 49% and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 45%, within the margin of error of two percentage points. In valid votes, Bolsonaro leads with 52% against 48% for Lula. The survey interviewed 2,520 people between October 6th and 7th, with a 95% confidence level.

item.title: Janones minimiza peso do apoio de candidatos derrotados a Flávio
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) downplayed the impact of endorsements from defeated candidates, such as Augusto Cury, supporting Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff, claiming these endorsements do not change the electoral landscape due to the limited political influence of these leaders. He noted that vote transfer only occurs effectively with endorsements from consolidated national leaders, unlike Lula, whose influence can mobilize voters. Janones also created 'Exército de Lula,' a WhatsApp channel with 2.7 million followers to guide supporters of the PT candidate.

item.title: Flávio vai ao TSE contra rede pró-Lula no Instagram
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a lawsuit at the TSE requesting the annulment of the Lula-Alckmin ticket and the suspension of 32 profiles deemed disinformation hubs on Instagram. The lawsuit accuses Lula's team of using the 'collab' co-authorship tool to spread false information about privatizations and coup attempts.

item.title: Indicado de Flávio para a Saúde trata atuação de Jair Bolsonaro na pandemia como 'capítulo superado'
item.description: Ophthalmologist Claudio Lottenberg, nominated by Flávio Bolsonaro for the Ministry of Health in a potential government, regards Jair Bolsonaro's pandemic management as a 'resolved chapter', criticizing the scientific denialism of his administration. Lottenberg, 66, emphasized the need to move past actions that harmed public health.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio aciona TSE contra Janja por vídeo nas redes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign filed a request with the TSE to remove a video posted by First Lady Janja, who accuses him of ending the Popular Pharmacy program and attacking rights. His defense claims the statements are misleading and lack evidence. The move follows a tight first-round race with Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.

item.title: Bia Lula rebate críticas a Janja e diz que Alckmin deve aparecer mais
item.description: Bia Lula defended First Lady Janja da Silva against criticism from PT militants. The president's granddaughter also suggested that Alckmin should be more present in the campaign and compared her family's political activity with that of the Bolsonaro clan.

item.title: Envio da MP do “imposto do pecado” será após eleições, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that the provisional measure for the selective tax, known as the 'sin tax', will be sent to Congress after the 2026 elections. The tax targets products harmful to health and the environment, such as alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, and cigarettes, maintaining the current IPI tax burden.

item.title: Após reação, grupo Hypers Kids Africa promete devolver criptomoedas recebidas por vídeo pró-Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Hypers Kids Africa group announced the return of 120 million $B22 tokens received for a pro-Flávio Bolsonaro video, following negative public reactions. The initiative involves children and young people from Uganda and has 12.9 million Instagram followers.

item.title: Paes reconhece fim da disputa pelo governo do RJ depois de reveses no TSE e no STF
item.description: Eduardo Paes acknowledged defeat in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial race after TSE and STF decisions annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes, preventing a runoff. Paes criticized the judicial decision and stated his party will monitor the new state government, particularly regarding public security crisis.

item.title: Apoio de ex-adversários leva a voto no segundo turno? O que diz CEO de instituto de pesquisa
item.description: Support from defeated candidates in the first round doesn't ensure vote transfer in the second round, according to Marcelo Tokarski, CEO of polling firm Nexus. He emphasizes that voter migration to Flávio Bolsonaro mainly stems from rejection of Lula, not formal alliances. Early polls suggest higher rejection of the president than the PL candidate, shaping the race dynamics.

item.title: Fux fechou cerco a atos de Moraes na trama golpista após se irritar com reunião entre ministro e chefe da PF
item.description: Supreme Court minister Luiz Fux publicly criticized fellow minister Alexandre de Moraes following a secret meeting between Moraes and Federal Police chief Andrei Rodrigues regarding the coup plot investigation. Fux's move was seen as an attempt to rein in Moraes's actions amid the 2026 elections.

item.title: Estudantes fazem manifestação por Lula e contra Flávio e Moro em Curitiba
item.description: Students in Curitiba protested in support of Lula's reelection and against Flávio and Moro, denouncing corruption and advocating for social policies on Thursday night.

item.title: Senado diz a Fux que divulgar visitas viola sigilo de congressistas
item.description: The Brazilian Senate told the Supreme Court that publishing visitor records could violate lawmakers' privacy and compromise their independence. The Senate's legal team argues that such data could expose political contacts and strategies protected by the Constitution. A city councilman requested access records for 8 individuals, including relatives of high-ranking officials, but the request was denied.

item.title: Bolsonarista saca arma e dá tiro pra cima durante ato pró-Lula em Sergipe
item.description: A military police sergeant identified as Manoel Messias dos Santos fired shots into the air during a pro-Lula demonstration at the Federal University of Sergipe in Aracaju. The officer was removed from duty and will undergo administrative proceedings with the PM Corps. The incident is classified as political violence by the Attorney General's Office.

item.title: Sem 2º turno no seu estado? Isso pode alterar o resultado da eleição para presidente
item.description: The absence of state elections in the second round across 21 of Brazil's 27 federative units may sway the presidential outcome, increasing voter abstention. This particularly impacts low-income voters who tend to support Lula, making the race against Flávio Bolsonaro more competitive.

item.title: Eduardo Paes reconhece derrota para Douglas Ruas no Rio
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) acknowledged his defeat to Douglas Ruas (PL) after a TSE decision annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes and ordered a recount, ensuring Ruas' victory with 49.27% of valid votes. Paes emphasized respect for the judicial decision and reaffirmed his commitment to the people of Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Prerrogativas diz que Vorcaro deu falso depoimento contra campanha de Lula e aciona PF
item.description: The legal group Prerrogativas accuses banker Daniel Vorcaro of giving false testimony to the Federal Police regarding an alleged donation of funds for an Oliver Stone film about Lula, and announces it will request the opening of an investigation. The accusation follows information suggesting Vorcaro was encouraged to testify about the alleged donation.

item.title: Por que tirar um voto do rival vale por dois no 2º turno, de acordo com CEO de instituto de pesquisa
item.description: Marcelo Tokarski, CEO of Nexus, explains that in the runoff between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, winning an opponent's voter is worth two advantages: it takes away one vote from the rival and adds one to your candidate. He notes that voter transfer will be decisive, particularly as pre-election polls show an edge for the PL. Tokarski describes the runoff as a 'basketball count', where each vote stolen from the opponent amplifies the gap.

item.title: Entenda os 8 compromissos que Flávio assumiu para ter o apoio de Cury no 2° turno
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) supports Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the runoff election, conditionally backing him based on eight commitments including ending presidential reelection, educational and healthcare reforms, women's protection, cooperatives support, and funding for small businesses.

item.title: Lula não ganha mais eleitores no Nordeste
item.description: Lula did not gain voters in the Northeast at the start of the second round, maintaining 63.8% of vote intentions according to Datafolha. Flávio Bolsonaro increased from 30.9% to 36.6%, gaining ground in the PT stronghold. The poll indicates consolidation of Lula's leadership in the region, but with progress by his opponent.

item.title: Quem é Cavala, a dona de bordel eleita deputada federal com quase 77 mil votos
item.description: Isa Jane Marcondes Nantes, known as 'Cavala', a 46-year-old businesswoman from the Republicans party, was elected federal congresswoman for Mato Grosso do Sul in the 2026 elections with 76,956 votes, becoming the 7th most-voted parliamentarian in the state. Her controversial background involving brothels and sex work has sparked debates about morality and sexuality in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Veja onde assistir Fluminense x Coritiba ao vivo nesta quinta-feira (08)
item.description: Fluminense and Coritiba face off in the 29th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship at 9:30 PM at Maracanã in Rio de Janeiro. The match is part of the national league and highlights key moments in Brazilian football.

item.title: Brasileiras buscam o Itamaraty após serem "caçadas" por deputado da Polônia
item.description: Two Brazilian women were targeted by Polish EU lawmaker Dominik Tarczyński after displaying PT symbols during voting in Poland. The Brazilian Foreign Ministry confirmed consular support to the citizens, while Tarczyński accused them of violating Polish laws against communism. The incident raised concerns about freedom of expression and political symbolism abroad.

item.title: Augusto Cury diz que apoio a Flávio Bolsonaro não é 'cheque em branco': 'Iremos cobrar'
item.description: Augusto Cury (Avante) announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the 2026 presidential runoff, emphasizing it is not a 'blank check' and that he will demand fulfillment of commitments. Cury, third place in the first round with over 3 million votes, decided to support the PL candidate after a conversation and signing a public commitment. The runoff is set for October 25, with Flávio (47.03%) facing Lula (PT, 45.15%).

item.title: Cristiano Zanin nega recurso de Paes e Ruas fica mais próximo do Palácio da Guanabara
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin rejected the appeal filed by Eduardo Paes' defense to suspend the TSE decision that annulled Anthony Garotinho's votes in the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election. As a result, Douglas Ruas (PL) moves closer to victory, and the Rio Electoral Court will recount the votes. The decision found insufficient procedural requirements for suspension, as the internal appeals at the TSE had not yet been exhausted.

item.title: Pavanato e Boulos trocam ofensas em aeroporto de Brasília
item.description: Elected federal deputy Lucas Pavanato (PL) released a video showing a heated exchange of insults with Minister Guilherme Boulos (PSOL) at Brasília International Airport. The recording contains profanities and political provocations, with both using aggressive language. The incident occurs amid tensions surrounding the 2026 second-round election campaign.

item.title: Governo projeta R$ 161 bi para portos, aeroportos e hidrovias até 2030
item.description: The federal government projects R$161.5 billion in investments for ports, airports, and inland waterways between 2027 and 2030. The plan aims to ensure continuity of infrastructure projects for the next administration, including the renegotiation of Viracopos Airport and the concession of TECON 10 at the Port of Santos.

item.title: Ato a favor de Lula em SP tem momentos de confusão
item.description: A pro-Lula rally in São Paulo gathered students from Mackenzie, USP, and PUC-SP, clashing with supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro. Military Police prevented the tension from escalating into physical attacks.

item.title: TSE aciona PF após ataques a servidores da Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) filed a request with the Federal Police to investigate around 30,000 cases of misinformation, improper disclosure of personal data, hate speech, and veiled threats against Justice of the Peace servers. TSE also notified social media platforms X and Meta about the spread of inappropriate content and strengthened security and psychological support for servers and their families.

item.title: Servidores do TSE são alvo de ataques nas redes e PF é acionada para investigar
item.description: TSE servers are targeted by social media attacks, with around 30 thousand posts identified, including misinformation and threats. The Federal Police was tasked with investigating, and the TSE stated that the attacks may constitute crimes. Servers and their families receive security reinforcement and psychological support.

item.title: 'Odeio branco': direita resgata supostas postagens antigas de petista mais votada em MG, que cita fake news e aciona TSE
item.description: Bolsonaro-aligned lawmakers resurface alleged old posts by elected lawmaker Ana Elisa Santos (PT), accusing her of racist statements; she denies the claims and threatens legal action at the TSE over fake news. The episode underscores the polarized 2026 election landscape, with Lula strengthening ties to younger lawmakers while facing criticism over the effectiveness of digital campaigning. Ana Elisa, the most-voted parliamentarian in Minas Gerais history, joins the new PT generation supporting Lula in the runoff against the PL.

item.title: Cury, Republicanos e terceira via: como Flávio amplia vantagem sobre Lula
item.description: Augusto Cury announced support for Flávio Bolsonaro after the senator signed a public commitment with the writer's proposals, including the end of presidential re-election. The Republicanos also partnered with the PL candidate, and the PSDB released its affiliates, expanding Flávio's lead over Lula according to Datafolha polling.

item.title: Lobista do caso INSS apoia Kátia Abreu e expõe racha em torno de Janja
item.description: Former senator Kátia Abreu, now in PT, criticized Janja's presence in Lula's campaign and advocated for greater protagonism for Geraldo Alckmin. Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, investigated in the INSS scandal, endorsed the criticism in a video. The case reveals internal cracks within PT.
